definitions.explanation: describes behavior or words that are clearly pretended or insincere

examples.japanese: {白々|しらじら}しい⟦{嘘|うそ}をつくな→嘘をつく：21763_usowotsuku⟧。
examples.english: Don't tell such an obvious lie.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{白々|しらじら}しかった。
⟦{知|し}っている→知る：00458_shiru⟧くせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{白々|しらじら}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Even though they know, they're pretending not to with a straight face.

notes:
USAGE:
- {白々|しらじら}しい⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧ (blatant lie)
- {白々|しらじら}しい⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (feigned attitude)
- {白々|しらじら}しい⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to put on an innocent face)
Strongly implies the speaker can see through the pretense. Used when someone's deception or insincerity is painfully obvious.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{空々|そらぞら}しい→空々しい：08222_sorazorashii⟧ (similar meaning - forced, unnatural)
- {白|しら}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to feign ignorance)

FORMS:
- Adverb: {白々|しらじら}しく
